annotation.description: Scene of peoples on a beach swimming on stand up paddles. First there is a blond girl in a blue bikini whos paddeling away from the beach, then the camera shifts to 2 guys paddeling. The boards are white, gray and yellow. The weather looks sunny with only some clouds. There are some trees on the beach and behind it a brown hill. There are not much waves and they seem to have fun. The man in the end holding the board smiles and has brown hair.
